nom: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Tea-Trica B5 Cream

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin report the cream hydrates without feeling slick, shiny, or greasy, keeping oily spots under control.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin, especially in winter, describe good relief from dryness and tightness around the mouth and cheeks, though a few found the hydration insufficient for very dry or winter conditions.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers say it balances oily and dry areas across seasons, though one found it too light in winter and disliked the tea tree oil for daily use.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive or rosacea-prone skin generally report calming, soothing effects with no flare-ups, though one worried the tea tree oil might not suit sensitive skin and one found the scent too strong.
segments.normal: Reviewers with normal skin describe it as working well morning and night, layering nicely under makeup without clogging pores.
segments.mature: One reviewer in her 30s with combination-leaning-dry skin found the hydration lacking for her needs, suggesting it may suit younger skin better.

concerns.aging: No reviewer specifically discusses anti-aging effects; skin appears smoother and more balanced with use, but no wrinkle- or firmness-specific claims are made.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers describe strong, lightweight hydration that lasts through the day or night, but a few with dry or combination skin found it not moisturizing enough, especially in winter.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers with rosacea or general redness report calming and reduced flare-ups; no dissent is mentioned.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers describe stronger, more balanced, less irritated skin over consistent use, citing centella and B5 for barrier support; no negative reports.
concerns.spots: Most reviewers with acne-prone skin report breakouts healing faster or being reduced, but one reviewer describes cystic-style overdrying concerns being avoided while another felt the tea tree component was “off” and not ideal for daily blemish control.
concerns.blemishes: Reviewers note fewer breakouts and calmer problem areas with regular use; one long-term combination-skin user found the added tea tree oil unwelcome in a daily moisturizer despite liking tea tree oil generally.
concerns.oiliness: Oily-skin reviewers say it hydrates without adding shine or heaviness, keeping skin balanced rather than greasy.

aspects.libelle: Layers well under makeup and sunscreen
Insufficient richness for winter or very dry skin

extraits.titre: Hydration falls short because of the tea tree oil
extraits.texte: I get what this product is trying to do. It feels like a 2-in-1 that mixes tea tree oil for blemishes with a thick hydrating moisturizer. I don't mind tea tree oil on its own, but having it blended into a moisturizer this rich throws me off. My skin is combo, drier in the winter and oily in the summer, so I'm fine using tea tree oil when my skin can handle it (summer time), but when it's winter time, and I want to dry out pimples, I stick to using either tret or benzoyl peroxide (which both don't have scents). I just don't always want it in my daily moisturizer, esp. one with a weird artificial smelling tea tree oil. IDK something is off about the tea tree oil in this moisturizer... which is weird because I do love the scent of tea tree oil, esp. ones sourced from Australia. Also, IMO, the hydration was also lighter than I expected given the other ingredients. I'm guessing the tea tree oil and the mattifying angle work against the moisture level a bit. It's not bad if you want something that targets the occasional pimple, but as a straight hydrating moisturizer, it didn't quite deliver for me as someone in her 30s and has combo (leaning drier) skin in the winter time. Would recommend this for those who are younger and/or have combo skin that's more oily or dry, acne prone skin.

I received this Tea-Trica B5 Cream as a complimentary gift from BzzAgent in exchange for my honest review. I have very sensitive skin with rosacea and get painful flare-ups, and this moisturizer felt nice on my skin! It was very cooling, and has a gel-cream hybrid consistency. It is thicker than a gel and hydrates well. The only thing I don't love is the scent, it's a little too earthy and fragrant for me!

I'm quite impressed after this product was gifted to me by BzzAgent, it arrived at a perfect time as I've had tremendous stress lately and found myself battling a persistent bout of acne. This product worked well over the course of nearly a week to reduce redness and irritation, as well as the pimples themselves, without over drying my skin!
This feels so good and nourishing on my sensitive, rosacea covered face. It doesn't cause any flare ups and feels so soothing. I have loved everything I have tried from skin1004.
I've been suffering with dry skin especially around my mouth and cheeks ever since using this product I've no longer had any dryness. This is my new go to product and will continue using this daily.

I received this moisturizer complimentary from BzzAgent in exchange for my honest review. I have oily skin, and finding a product that hydrates without leaving a heavy or greasy feeling can be a challenge — but this one really impressed me. The texture feels lightweight and refreshing, and it soaks into my skin almost instantly. Even with my oily skin, it never feels slick or shiny throughout the day. Instead, it gives me a balanced, hydrated feel that keeps my skin comfortable and smooth. Overall, it's been such a nice addition to my routine, and I'm genuinely happy with how well it works for my skin type.

Good ingredients. It has a smell, but I know it is part of the natural scene of the ingredients. I will use this when my skin is feeling oily and probably avoid it when dry, but it seems to work pretty well for breakouts.
